exposure: Use of cold-scalpel blade for subcutaneous incision
Use of electrocautery blade for subcutaneous incisions
cohort: 149 women undergoing repeat Cesarean delivery with Pfannenstiel incision.
finding: The use of electrocautery for subcutaneous incisions was associated with lower blood loss and lower postoperative pain compared to the cold-scalpel incisions in pregnant women undergoing repeat C-sections with Pfannenstiel incision.
